overview_description.description:
WeTravel is an online payment platform that offers organizers with pre-departure tools to collect funds and organize logistics.

Travel companies create elegant booking pages in minutes to collect deposits, set automatic payment plans, and manage financials securely from all over the world.

Its platform has been used for a wide variety of trips, such as yoga retreats, student trips, bachelorette trips, dance trips, company retreats or sports team travel. Its website allows organizers to create a beautiful website for their trip in minutes. Organizers can collect deposits directly on the Wetravel platform and then easily transfer the funds to their account or directly to a travel agent or airline (even internationally, at much better exchange rates than banks.

about_short_description.short_description: WeTravel is an online payment platform that offers organizers with pre-departure tools to collect funds and organize logistics.

product.name: Itinerary Builder
product.description: A tool to create and share detailed travel itineraries in various formats including mobile app, desktop, and PDF with live flight tracking.

product.name: Payment Processing
product.description: A system that enables collection of payments in multiple currencies and methods, while paying organizers in their preferred currency and reducing fees.

product.name: Booking Management
product.description: A platform to manage traveler bookings, including add-ons, discount codes, room inventory, payment plans, eSignatures, and automated reminders.

product.name: Traveler Manifest
product.description: A centralized dashboard that collects and shares detailed booking information for trips, accessible to teams and suppliers.

product.name: Supplier Payouts
product.description: A service to pay suppliers globally with instant, free payout options and automatic payment tracking.
